attendance_times.name: attendance_times
attendance_times.value: ("attendance_record"."arrival" is null or "attendance_record"."arrival" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$') and ("attendance_record"."departure" is null or "attendance_record"."departure" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')

gradebook_recovery_approval.name: gradebook_recovery_approval
gradebook_recovery_approval.value: "gradebook_recovery_request"."status"<>'approved' or ("gradebook_recovery_request"."physical_follow_up" and "gradebook_recovery_request"."decided_by" is not null and "gradebook_recovery_request"."decision" is not null)

gradebook_writing_scope.name: gradebook_writing_scope
gradebook_writing_scope.value: ("gradebook_writing"."kind"='homeroom_note' and "gradebook_writing"."offering_id" is null) or ("gradebook_writing"."kind"<>'homeroom_note' and "gradebook_writing"."offering_id" is not null)
